# Tumblr

> > A microblogging and social networking platform for sharing multimedia content, creative communities, fandoms, and customizable HTML themes.

Tumblr is a blogging platform known for its creative communities, reblog culture, and extensive customization options. It supports photos, GIFs, text posts, and custom HTML themes, with strong communities around fandoms, art, and tutorials.

## Key Topics

- Tumblr platform
- HTML theme customization
- Photo uploading and galleries
- Reblogging and fandoms
- Custom themes and NPF
- GIF creation and Photoshop
- Browser compatibility (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge)
- Alt text and accessibility
- Neocities and indie web
- Community tutorials
- Content exploration
- User safety and scam prevention

## Getting Started

- [Tumblr](https://tumblr.com/@): Main Tumblr homepage showcasing reblogs, fandoms, memes, and art content
- [Photos | Tumblr](https://tumblr.com/explore/photos): Photo exploration and browsing gallery for discovering visual content
- [Adding Photos – Tumblr Help Center](https://help.tumblr.com/knowledge-base/adding-photos): Guide for uploading photos, adding filters, stickers, and alt text to posts

## Theme Development & Customization

- [Creating a custom HTML theme | Tumblr](https://tumblr.com/docs/en/custom_themes): Complete HTML theme development reference with NPF, variables, and tags

## Community Tutorials

- [GIFMAKING FOR BEGINNERS – @hayaosmiyazaki on Tumblr](https://tumblr.com/hayaosmiyazaki/622410677786705920/gifmaking-for-beginners-as-requested-this-is-a): Comprehensive Photoshop gifmaking tutorial from download to Tumblr posting
- [[tutorial: build your own neocities/nekoweb page] – @numbpill on Tumblr](https://tumblr.com/numbpill/779499537379344384/tutorial-build-your-own-neocitiesnekoweb-page): Beginner's HTML/CSS tutorial for creating indie web pages on Neocities
- [How to Use Famitracker - Chapter 1, Introduction – @btothethree on Tumblr](https://tumblr.com/btothethree/104644129447/how-to-use-famitracker-chapter-1-introduction): Famitracker music tracker tutorial series introduction for NES chiptune
- [#tutorial – @vyxated on Tumblr](https://tumblr.com/vyxated/tagged/tutorial): User blog archive of Sims 4 modding tutorials and UI customization guides

## Help & Safety

- [Avoiding Scammers – Tumblr Help Center](https://help.tumblr.com/knowledge-base/avoiding-scammers): Safety guide for identifying and avoiding phishing scams and impersonation

## Optional

- [А. П. Чехов "Чайка" Монолог Треплева. I действие](https://nekto-nekto.tumblr.com/post/121018786848/а-п-чехов-чайка-монолог-треплева-i-действие): User blog post featuring Chekhov's 'The Seagull' Treplev monologue excerpt
